name: product-discovery
description: Product discovery and prototyping workflows: public customer research, affinity mapping, desk research, interview planning, data analysis, and art-directed landing pages.

interface.longDescription: Turn customer opinions, research notes, interview transcripts, business questions, and datasets into evidence-led decisions. Build a distinctive landing page through a guided brief, independent art direction, and visual iteration.
defaultPrompt: Synthesize these interview transcripts with affinity mapping.
Research this product decision and challenge my assumptions.
Create an interview plan from these research notes.
Find public customer opinions about this product and create a short report with grouped quotes.
